Nora (Pilot): Hey team, pilot devices are getting 429s on /v1/preflight right after a scheduled sync. ~35% failures within first 45s.

Diego (CS): Thanks Nora. Which SDK/version and are you using ephemeral tokens?

Nora (Pilot): SDK 1.9.0, ephemeral tokens minted at client start. We spawn a sync worker per account and don't reuse HTTP clients.

Riya (Eng): Likely token-fanout + new TLS handshakes. Quick fixes: reuse a global HTTP client, add randomized start jitter (0-3000ms), and limit concurrent preflight calls per process (<=5). Also dedupe token refreshes per device.

Nora (Pilot): We'll patch to reuse OkHttp, add jitter and semaphore. Any server-side options?

Diego (CS): We can enable preflight coalescing for a short window and temporarily raise burst allowance while you run the canary. I'll flip a flag in staging first.

flag-bot: preflight_coalesce=true rolled for tenant=pilot at 2026-03-29T21:10:00Z. Monitor preflight_429_rate and preflight_latency.

Nora (Pilot): Implementing client changes now, will run a 1k-device canary and share headers: x-edge-node, request-id, x-device-id.

Riya (Eng): Sounds good. If 429s persist include example traces; we'll enable deeper sampling. Also honor Retry-After when returned and apply exponential backoff with jitter for silent 429s.

Nora (Pilot): Thanks all, will report results tomorrow.
